findings: Solar output shows no day/night cycle (night mean ~ noon mean).
Solar power is uncorrelated with irradiance.
Wind power is uncorrelated with wind speed.
Load has no autocorrelation: consecutive 15-min values are independent.
Recorded generation/battery/grid flows do not satisfy the power balance.
Recorded battery SOC jumps far faster than any physical battery could move.
Column 'optimal_energy_dispatch' is simply generation minus load (not an optimized schedule).
